advice.zh: 【Birdland 供應鏈週報】本週亞洲—美西運價因GRI與港口擁堵而上漲 (紐約漲 3%, 洛杉磯漲 5%), 亞洲—歐洲海運運價回軟 (鹿特丹跌 5%, 熱那亞跌 10%); 北美鋼價受關稅支撐穩定,全球趨勢分歧,中國鋼廠減產護價; 木材與塑膠粒則持續走軟。 Brent原油因荷姆茲海峽局勢高度不穩，伊朗持續針對商業航運而飆升至 $107.63 美元/桶。 建議:海運運價混合走勢,應戰略性訂艙,並分批鎖定鋼質料件與燃料相關投入。美方新關稅措施已生效,請留意。 法規面 EUDR(2026/12/30)木柄文件請務必提早備齊,並留意PPWR(2026/8/12)對包裝PFAS的限制,該限制已生效。 需要我們協助規劃備料節奏與文件,隨時聯繫。
advice.en: [Birdland Supply-Chain Brief] Transpacific ocean freight rates have sharply increased (New York up 3%, Los Angeles up 5%), while Asia–Europe rates are softening (Rotterdam down 5%, Genoa down 10%); North American steel prices are stable, supported by tariffs, while global trends are mixed with China mills cutting production to defend prices; lumber and resin continue to soften. Brent crude surged to $107.63 USD/bbl on September 10, 2026, as the Strait of Hormuz remains severely disrupted with Iran continuing to target commercial shipping. We suggest strategically booking ocean space given the mixed freight trends, and phasing in steel-input and fuel-linked cover. New US tariff measures are now in effect, requiring close monitoring. On compliance, prepare EUDR (30 Dec 2026) timber documentation early and thoroughly, and note PPWR (12 Aug 2026) PFAS limits for packaging, which are now in effect. Contact us to plan your buying cadence and paperwork.
